objectives.text: Recognize a singleton and explain the risk of hidden global state
Recognize a static factory method and explain what it hides from the caller
Decide when passing a dependency in is simpler than using a singleton

minutes.basis: Intake planning budget for a reading page under the new-course rule in workflow/docs/tools/validators.md (B8): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 and modeledWorstPath are 0 (not measured), not estimates. The planning value is the largest ceil(max(estimator P50, worst path)) measured on a course-1 page (10 minutes, agile-scrum-user-stories), reduced to 8 for a Reading page. The module PR measures the authored page with the frozen estimator, models the worst required path, and raises budget and aboutLabel to at least ceil(max(P50, modeledWorstPath)), at most 15, without compressing other topics. See workflow/evidence/java-foundations/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
